query: SELECT enrollment.team_id,enrollment.item_id,enrollment.key_id FROM password_totp_enrollments enrollment JOIN password_item_entities item ON item.team_id=enrollment.team_id AND item.id=enrollment.item_id WHERE (item.totp_key_id IS DISTINCT FROM enrollment.key_id OR item.deleting) AND (enrollment.cleanup_started_at IS NULL OR enrollment.cleanup_after<=now()) ORDER BY enrollment.cleanup_after LIMIT 100
